Welcome to 43 Bowler Street, a charming residence nestled in the heart of the popular Paddington. This spacious three bedroom plus a study, home offers the perfect blend of character & modern comfort, ideal for families or professionals seeking space, style & convenience.

Inside, you'll find a warm & inviting living room featuring a beautiful character fireplace solidifying the idea of comfort. The home is equipped with air conditioning & ceiling fans throughout, ensuring year round comfort. All three bedrooms, as well as the living area, are carpeted, adding a soft, homely feel & the separate study provides an ideal space for working from home or managing the household.

The kitchen is both functional & stylish, featuring ample storage & generous bench space to make meal preparation a breeze. Complete with a dishwasher for added convenience & efficient gas cooking, this well equipped kitchen caters perfectly to both everyday living and entertaining.

The bathroom is thoughtfully designed with a separate shower & bathtub, offering both functionality & comfort for busy mornings or relaxing evenings. This layout provides added convenience for families or shared living arrangements. The home also includes an internal laundry & a separate powder room for added practicality.

Step outside to a paved, undercover patio-ideal for entertaining or relaxing while overlooking the generous backyard, perfect for kids, pets, or weekend gardening. Additional storage is available in the undercroft, offering a secure place for tools, bikes, or seasonal items.

With two car spaces included, this home delivers comfortable living in one of Brisbane's most desirable inner city suburbs...
